records.public_claim_text: 1.1.1 This document serves as a companion to NPR 8715.6 and provides specific technical requirements for limiting orbital debris and methods to comply with the NASA requirements for limiting orbital debris generation.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: 1.1.1 This document serves as a companion to NPR 8715.6 and provides specific technical requirements for limiting orbital debris and methods to comply with the NASA requirements for limiting orbital debris generation.

records.public_claim_text: 1.1.2 This standard is primarily designed to limit the creation of new orbital debris and, therefore, to limit the risk to other current and future space missions.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: 1.1.2 This standard is primarily designed to limit the creation of new orbital debris and, therefore, to limit the risk to other current and future space missions.

records.public_claim_text: 1.2.6 NPR 7120.5 and NPR 8715.6 require the use of this document for development of Orbital Debris Assessments (ODA), Orbital Debris Assessment Reports (ODAR), and End of Mission Plans (EOMP).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: 1.2.6 NPR 7120.5 and NPR 8715.6 require the use of this document for development of Orbital Debris Assessments (ODA), Orbital Debris Assessment Reports (ODAR), and End of Mission Plans (EOMP).

records.public_claim_text: A failure mode identified by failure mode and effects analyses or equivalent analyses, for which a quantitative failure probability is available and exceeds 0.000001 (1:1,000,000).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: A failure mode identified by failure mode and effects analyses or equivalent analyses, for which a quantitative failure probability is available and exceeds 0.000001 (1:1,000,000).

records.public_claim_text: As defined in the 2019 ODMSP, a constellation consisting of 100 or more operational spacecraft cumulative is considered a large constellation.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: As defined in the 2019 ODMSP, a constellation consisting of 100 or more operational spacecraft cumulative is considered a large constellation.

records.public_claim_text: A medical condition received as a result of the falling debris which requires (or should have required) professional medical attention within 48 hours of the impact.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: A medical condition received as a result of the falling debris which requires (or should have required) professional medical attention within 48 hours of the impact.

records.public_claim_text: NPR 8715.6 requires that each program or project conduct a formal assessment of the potential to generate orbital debris.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: NPR 8715.6 requires that each program or project conduct a formal assessment of the potential to generate orbital debris.

records.public_claim_text: 4.1.3 Section 4.2 of this standard requires that programs and projects use the orbital debris modeling tools provided (or agreed to) by the NASA ODPO in assessing orbital debris generation and risk in Earth orbit.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: 4.1.3 Section 4.2 of this standard requires that programs and projects use the orbital debris modeling tools provided (or agreed to) by the NASA ODPO in assessing orbital debris generation and risk in Earth orbit.

records.public_claim_text: Any non-compliance with the requirements for ODAR and EOMPs stated in this standard requires NASA management approval of a waiver per NPR 8715.6.

records.public_claim_text: 4.3.1.2 The goal is that in all operational orbits, space systems are designed not to release debris during normal operations.
